name: Endangered Refugee by Thunderbirds - Gameable 2023
author: game_able
description: A game by Anastasia and Kesenya. It is a maze but without walls. There are different levels, the higher it is the harder it becomes. The characters will be endangered species that have to try to survive. (polar bear trying to join  his mom, sea turtle trying to find real food). There will be stars to collect to buy new characters and their environment.
